name: Homecoming Float Building!
description: Come and join us on the Furman Mall as we participate in the longtime Furman tradition of float-building! We will cookout (Thursday) and have pizza (Friday) on the mall, so don't worry about dinner. Come and share your construction and decoration skillz as we build a homecoming float!
